result:
PLAT-103 is live. PR #1 is merged, CI and CD both passed, and I ran `st done`.

- **Contract:** `validateApp` in `libs/shared-contracts/index.js` now throws `app.owner is required` when `owner` is missing, empty or whitespace.
- **Apps:** core-shell passes `platform`, billing passes `payments` and reports passes `insights`. These match each app's `package.json` `team`. All three build locally and pass the contract check.
- **PR:** [PR #1](https://github.com/dlockamy/homelab-mfe-monorepo/pull/1) is the only PR. It touches the one lib and the three apps together, since they have to land in order.
- **Assumptions:** the owner strings are hardcoded in source, because the custom bundlers don't import `package.json`. Nothing checks that they still match `team`. I left the shared-contracts version at 1.0.0 because it's inlined from `libs/` and never published. `validateApp` is called only in this monorepo, so I didn't touch platformkit.

My first `sed` edits failed on macOS and made nothing, and the first `st pr open` call errored. I redid the edits with perl and nothing else was affected.
